# Asset provenance

All map, building, tree, train, track, bridge and station mesh construction code was authored for this project. The UI click is synthesized in code. The music (`Assets/Game/Resources/Audio/Music/*.wav`) consists of arrangements of public-domain compositions (Johann Strauss II, Mozart, Vivaldi, Joplin, Grieg, Waldteufel, Beethoven, Dvořák, Brahms, Satie, Offenbach, J. S. Bach, Debussy and Chopin, all written between about 1725 and 1905, their composers dead for more than 100 years). The notes were transcribed for this project into `Tools/music/pieces/` and are rendered from scratch by the synthesizer in `Tools/compose_music.py`; no recordings, samples or copyrighted editions are included. The TR-808-style drum beat under every piece (kick, snare, clap, hi-hats, 808 bass) is likewise synthesized from sines, square oscillators and noise in `Tools/music/synth.py`; no drum-machine samples are used. The sound effects (`Assets/Game/Resources/Audio/Sfx/*.wav`) are likewise synthesized from sines and filtered noise by `Tools/compose_sfx.py`, with no samples or recordings. No OpenTTD assets or paid assets are used.

Liberation Sans and TextMeshPro essential resources come from Unity's installed `com.unity.ugui` package. The upstream font license is retained in `Assets/TextMesh Pro/Fonts/LiberationSans - OFL.txt`. Unity packages remain governed by their own package licenses.
